Script.name: AM Import Full Flights and Legs

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: HISTORICAL YEAR: ScriptParameter = full calendar year (e.g. 2025)

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: YOY: ScriptParameter = yoy → YTD prior year + YTD current → *_YOY

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: MISSIONS: STO Day/24h = Legs from JsonFlightRaw; other = MissionCount (default 1)

Step.name: If
Step.Calculation: ( Left ( $base ; 4 ) = "STO " or $base = "Stockholm" ) and $missions > 0 and GetAsNumber ( AM_Imported_Flights::MissionCount ) ≠ $missions

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: IFR/NVG/Night: flight fields first; else PIC from AM_FlightPersonnel (fixes empty 2025 imports)

Step.name: If
Step.Calculation:
IsEmpty ( $base )
or
PatternCount ( $base ; "Arlanda" ) > 0
or
PatternCount ( $base ; "Simu" ) > 0
or
PatternCount ( $base ; "Tech" ) > 0

Value.Calculation: "SELECT AM_FlightPersonnel.FlightId, AM_FlightPersonnel.PilotName, SUM ( AM_FlightPersonnel.MissionCount ), SUM ( AM_FlightPersonnel.CommandHours ), SUM ( AM_FlightPersonnel.CopilotHours ) FROM AM_FlightPersonnel INNER JOIN AM_Imported_Flights ON AM_FlightPersonnel.FlightId = AM_Imported_Flights.FlightId WHERE AM_FlightPersonnel.Deleted = 0 AND AM_Imported_Flights.FlightDate >= ?/*ENDDATE*/ AND ( AM_FlightPersonnel.CommandDay > 0 OR AM_FlightPersonnel.CommandNight > 0 OR AM_FlightPersonnel.CoPilotDay > 0 OR AM_FlightPersonnel.CopilotNight > 0 ) GROUP BY AM_FlightPersonnel.FlightId, AM_FlightPersonnel.PilotName HAVING SUM ( AM_FlightPersonnel.CommandHours ) > 0 OR SUM ( AM_FlightPersonnel.CopilotHours ) > 0 ORDER BY AM_FlightPersonnel.FlightId, SUM ( AM_FlightPersonnel.MissionCount ) DESC"
GetAsNumber ( Substitute ( GetValue ( $tpfParts ; 4 ) ; "." ; "," ) ) + GetAsNumber ( Substitute ( GetValue ( $tpfParts ; 5 ) ; "." ; "," ) )

Step.name: If
Step.Calculation: not IsEmpty ( $tpfType ) and not IsEmpty ( $tpfPilot ) and $tpfHours > 0

Script.name: AM Update FlightPersonnel Pilot Hour Categories
